hero.title: Solutions in Sustainable Plastics
hero.subtitle: At Liderplast, we drive biodegradable and traditional solutions with a responsible approach, aligned with the demands of the present and a commitment to the future.

about.seoDescription: Learn the history of Liderplast, from our beginnings in 2015 to becoming a benchmark in sustainable and traditional plastic solutions in Cúcuta.
about.title: From a family dream to a benchmark in sustainable solutions
about.paragraph1: Liderplast was born in 2015 as a family micro-enterprise focused on distributing disposable products. With effort, customer proximity, and a forward-thinking vision, we grew step by step to become a recognized brand in the sector.
about.paragraph2: Today, we combine our commercial experience with a real commitment to the environment, offering both biodegradable products and traditional options, always with the backing of quality and responsibility that defines us.
about.philosophyText: More than a distributor, we are an ally for your business and an agent of change for the planet. Our mission is to offer practical, quality solutions that meet the needs of today's market without compromising the future.
about.timeline1Text: We were born as a family micro-enterprise, with the dream of supplying the local market with quality disposable products.
about.timeline2Text: We consolidated our position in Cúcuta, expanding our catalog and customer base thanks to trust and service.
about.timeline3Text: We are leading the transition to sustainability, introducing biodegradable products and maintaining our commitment to innovation.
